messages.content: What is the name of this demonstration robot?
The demonstration robot is named Cedar.
Cedar operates in the demonstration greenhouse.
What does the demonstration robot measure?
Cedar measures soil moisture in the demonstration greenhouse.
What should Cedar do when the soil is dry?
Cedar reports dry soil to the operator. The operator decides whether to water it.
Can Cedar water plants on its own?
No. Cedar only measures soil moisture and reports it to the operator.
Cedar is a demonstration robot that reports greenhouse soil moisture to an operator.
